summary.en: K230 Machines maintainer; reviewer for RISC-V TCG CPUs and Checkpatch.
summary.zh: K230 Machines 维护者，RISC-V TCG CPU 与 Checkpatch 评审者。

summary.en: HUMANIZE 1.0 maintainer team member; review prompts and methodology contributions.
summary.zh: HUMANIZE 1.0 维护团队成员，参与评审提示词与方法论改进。

summary.en: AIA/IMSIC interrupt backend, topology-aware tests and QEMU virt bring-up.
summary.zh: AIA/IMSIC 中断后端、拓扑感知测试与 QEMU virt 适配。

summary.en: RV real-time verification documentation merged in Linux 7.3.
summary.zh: RV 实时验证文档，已合入 Linux 7.3。

summary.en: OSTD documentation and CPU fault-signal semantics on x86 and LoongArch.
summary.zh: OSTD 文档，以及 x86 与 LoongArch 的 CPU 故障信号语义。

summary.en: QEMU package spec and rvsp-ref patches for the RISC-V distribution.
summary.zh: 面向 RISC-V 发行版的 QEMU 软件包 spec 与 rvsp-ref 补丁。

title.en: Linux 7.3 merged the RV sleep-monitor documentation patch
title.zh: Linux 7.3 合入 RV 睡眠监控文档补丁

summary.en: Documentation/rv explains epoll_wait() and aborted sleeps for the rtapp sleep monitor; authored on 29 July and merged through the tracing tree for 7.3.
summary.zh: Documentation/rv 补充 rtapp 睡眠监控中的 epoll_wait() 与中止睡眠语义；7 月 29 日提交，经 tracing 树合入 7.3。

title.en: Became a QEMU K230 Machines maintainer
title.zh: 成为 QEMU K230 Machines 维护者

summary.en: The K230 board series added the K230 Machines entry with Chao Liu as maintainer; Alistair Francis merged the series.
summary.zh: K230 板级支持系列在 MAINTAINERS 中新增 K230 Machines 条目，由 Chao Liu 担任维护者；Alistair Francis 合入。

title.zh: 成为 QEMU Checkpatch 评审者

summary.en: MAINTAINERS patch adding Chao Liu as Checkpatch reviewer; reviewed by Philippe Mathieu-Daudé and merged by Markus Armbruster.
summary.zh: MAINTAINERS 补丁新增 Chao Liu 为 Checkpatch 评审者；Philippe Mathieu-Daudé 评审，Markus Armbruster 合入。

summary.en: GitHub lists Chao Liu with the admin role on the RustSBI organization and rustsbi/rustsbi; the organization profile was last updated on 10 May 2026.
summary.zh: GitHub 记录显示 Chao Liu 在 RustSBI 组织与 rustsbi/rustsbi 仓库拥有管理员角色；组织资料更新于 2026 年 5 月 10 日。

title.en: RustSBI merged the AIA/IMSIC backend for QEMU virt
title.zh: RustSBI 合入 QEMU virt 的 AIA/IMSIC 中断后端

summary.en: PR #210 added AIA/IMSIC interrupt support, topology-aware tests and openEuler boot coverage, merged by Zhouqi Jiang.
summary.zh: PR #210 增加 AIA/IMSIC 中断支持、拓扑感知测试与 openEuler 启动覆盖，由蒋周奇合入。

title.zh: 加入 HUMANIZE 1.0 maintainer 团队

summary.en: The PolyArch humanize-maintainer team was created on 14 April 2026 at 07:29 CST for Humanize maintainers; Chao Liu is a member.
summary.zh: PolyArch 的 humanize-maintainer 团队于 2026 年 4 月 14 日 07:29（北京时间）创建，用于 HUMANIZE 维护者；Chao Liu 是团队成员。

title.en: Asterinas merged CPU exception to fault-signal mapping
title.zh: Asterinas 合入 CPU 异常到故障信号的映射

summary.en: PR #3120 mapped x86 and LoongArch debug and breakpoint exceptions to SIGTRAP and added regression tests; PR #3062 embedded README documentation for ostd and int-to-c-enum.
summary.zh: PR #3120 将 x86 与 LoongArch 的调试、断点异常映射为 SIGTRAP 并补充回归测试；PR #3062 为 ostd 与 int-to-c-enum 嵌入 README 文档。

title.en: Became a QEMU RISC-V TCG CPU reviewer
title.zh: 成为 QEMU RISC-V TCG CPU 评审者

summary.en: The MAINTAINERS patch was submitted on 26 February and merged by Alistair Francis on 19 March, with reviews from Bin Meng, Daniel Henrique Barboza and Liu Zhiwei.
summary.zh: MAINTAINERS 补丁于 2 月 26 日提交，3 月 19 日由 Alistair Francis 合入；Bin Meng、Daniel Henrique Barboza 与 Liu Zhiwei 评审。

title.en: openRuyi packaged QEMU with rvsp-ref patches
title.zh: openRuyi 引入 QEMU 软件包与 rvsp-ref 补丁

summary.en: The openRuyi QEMU spec credits Chao Liu as a file contributor; the package carries rvsp-ref patches authored on 5 January 2026.
summary.zh: openRuyi 的 QEMU spec 将 Chao Liu 列为文件贡献者；软件包包含 2026 年 1 月 5 日编写的 rvsp-ref 补丁。
